chunks: Visiting the grave of the Commander of the Faithful, may the blessings of Allah be upon him.

When you come to al-Ghariyy on the outskirts of al-Kufah, then perform ghusl (ritual bath) and walk with calmness and dignity until you come to the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام. Then face him with your face and say: Peace be upon you, O Wali of Allah. You are the first wronged one and the first whose right was usurped. You were patient and sought reward until certainty came to you. I bear witness that you met Allah, Mighty and Majestic, while you were a martyr. May Allah punish your killer with various kinds of punishment and renew the punishment upon him. I have come to you recognizing your right, having insight into your station, showing enmity to your enemies and to whoever wronged you. I commit myself to that before my Lord, if Allah wills. Indeed, I have many sins, so intercede for me with your Lord, for indeed you have with Allah, Blessed and Exalted, a known station, and indeed you have with Allah rank and intercession. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said:
"And they do not intercede except for one whom He approves."

key_terms.الْغَرِيَّ: Al-Ghariyy, the sacred location of the grave near al-Kufah.
key_terms.جَاهًا: Honor, rank, and standing before Allah.
key_terms.شَفَاعَةً: Intercession by Allah’s permission on behalf of others.
key_terms.شَهِيدٌ: A martyr who met Allah through unjust killing.
key_terms.مَظْلُومٍ: One who was wronged or oppressed unjustly.
key_terms.مَقَامًا مَعْلُومًا: A known and established station with Allah.
key_terms.وَلِيَّ اللَّهِ: The friend and guardian of Allah; a title of spiritual authority and closeness.

ai.seo_question: What should be said when visiting the grave of Imam Ali عليه السلام and asking for his intercession?
ai.summary: This text teaches the etiquette of visiting the grave of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, including ghusl (ritual bath), calm conduct, salutations, and seeking his shafa'ah (intercession). It affirms his مظلوميّة, martyrdom, and lofty rank with Allah, while concluding with a Qur'anic statement about intercession being for those whom Allah is pleased with.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: VISITING THE GRAVE OF THE COMMANDER OF THE FAITHFUL, PEACE BE UPON HIM

Hadith.3196 - When you come to al-Ghariyy, on the outskirts of Kufa, perform ghusl (ritual purification), and walk with calmness and dignity until you reach the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him. Face him with your body and say:
"Peace be upon you, O friend of Allah (swt). You are the first who was wronged and the first whose right was usurped. You were patient and sought reward until certainty (death) came to you. I bear witness that you met Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, as a martyr. May Allah (swt) punish your killer with various forms of torment and renew that torment upon him.
I have come to you recognizing your right, understanding your station, opposing your enemies and those who wronged you. I place this before my Lord (azj), if Allah (swt) wills. I have many sins, so intercede for me with your Lord (azj), for you have a known station with Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, and you hold a position of honor and intercession with Him. Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted, has said, ‘
They do not intercede except for those with whom He is pleased.’"
